count_cats.description: Count the cats in the library, or only those with the tags you name: the check before asking for a cat by tag, which fails when no cat has them. No API key required.
count_cats.name: count_cats

parameters.description: Optional. Count only the cats with these tags. Separate several with commas; a cat must carry every one. Tags match exactly, capitals included, so run List tags for the library's own spelling.
parameters.name: tags

tags.description: The tags the cats were counted by, if any.

get_cat.description: Get one particular cat by its id: its tags, its type and when it was added, with a link to its picture at the size and with the effects you ask for, and the picture as a file if you want it. No API key required.
get_cat.name: get_cat

parameters.description: The id of the cat to get. Every action that returns a cat reports its id, and a CATAAS link to the cat works too.
parameters.name: cat_id

parameters.description: Optional. One of CATAAS's own sizes. Original size by default. Square crops to 200 x 200; the others set the width and keep the cat's proportions. For any other size, leave this and set Width and Height.
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: Optional. The width in pixels, 1 to 1000, the most CATAAS draws. Alone, it keeps the cat's proportions; with a height too, Fit decides how the cat fills that box.
parameters.name: width

parameters.description: Optional. The height in pixels, 1 to 1000, the most CATAAS draws. Alone, it keeps the cat's proportions; with a width too, Fit decides how the cat fills that box.
parameters.name: height

parameters.description: Optional. How the cat fills a box set by both Width and Height: crop to fill it (the default), fit inside it with black bars, stretch to it, shrink to fit inside it without bars, or grow to cover it without cropping.
parameters.name: fit

options.label: Shrink to fit inside, no bars
Grow to cover the size, no crop

parameters.description: Optional. Which part of the cat to keep when it is cropped or barred to fit a box. The center by default; choose Top to keep a cat's head in a wide crop.
parameters.name: position

parameters.description: Optional. Black and white, or a negative. None by default. Cannot be combined with the adjustments below; for black and white with other adjustments, set Saturation to 0 instead.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Optional. How much to blur the picture, from 1 (a light softening) to 1000. Around 10 is heavy. Leave empty or 0 for a sharp picture.
parameters.name: blur

parameters.description: Optional. Multiplies the brightness: 1 leaves it as it is, 0.5 halves it, 1.5 is half as bright again.
parameters.name: brightness

parameters.description: Optional. Multiplies the colour: 1 leaves it as it is, 0 turns the picture black and white, 2 makes it twice as vivid.
parameters.name: saturation

parameters.description: Optional. Turns every colour round the colour wheel by this many degrees, -360 to 360: 180 makes an orange cat blue.
parameters.name: hue

parameters.description: Optional. Adds to the lightness, -100 to 100: 20 lifts the whole picture towards white, -20 pushes it towards black.
parameters.name: lightness

parameters.description: Optional. A colour to tint the picture with, keeping its light and dark: a colour name such as 'orange', a hex code such as '#3366FF', or red, green and blue such as '255, 136, 0'.
parameters.name: tint_color

parameters.description: Off by default, because the link is all a chat message, an email or a web page needs. Turn it on when a later step needs the file itself: attaching it to an email, uploading it to storage, or posting it as a file.
parameters.display_name: Also save the picture as a file

description: Pull cat pictures and GIFs from CATAAS (Cat as a service), a free library of about 2,000 cats tagged by the people who shared them. Get a random cat or one with the tags you name (cute, orange, sleeping), make a cat say something in a meme-style caption, and resize, crop, blur or recolour it on the way. Every cat comes with a link that always shows that same picture, ready for a chat message or an email, and can be saved as a file to attach. No account or API key required.
